How often should I get Air Duct Cleaning done in a coastal area like Huntington Beach? Due to the high levels of humidity and fine beach sand infiltration, we generally recommend professional Air Duct Cleaning every 2-3 years, or annually if you have pets, allergies, or run your HVAC system year-round to combat the humidity. Does the salty ocean air affect my dryer vent performance? Yes. The salt-laden air can contribute to the internal corrosion of the metal venting over time. More immediately, the high humidity slows down the drying process, making regular Dryer Vent Cleaning even more critical to prevent fire hazards and excessive energy use. Is mold and mildew a bigger concern for carpet and ductwork in Huntington Beach? Absolutely. Huntington Beach's persistent high humidity creates an ideal breeding ground for mold and mildew, particularly in your ducts and deep within carpets.
